status: Proposed physical validation; no experiments have been performed for this project
purpose: Measure the preparation-history effect, confirm nominal-recipe performance under independent preparation and replace assumed resource costs with platform-specific measurements.
materials_scope: The two OPV blend systems in Langner et al. provide recorded compositions and measured photostability outcomes. They do not provide the carryover, wash-response or independent-preparation cost calibration required here.
before_execution: Use an established platform-specific preparation and assay procedure approved by the laboratory.
Freeze candidate recipe, performance threshold, measurement endpoint and analysis before collecting confirmation outcomes.
Choose one validated composition-sensitive measurement for residual transfer. A performance shift alone cannot identify chemical carryover.
Record the detection and quantification limits and the calibration uncertainty of the composition measurement.
Specify what independent fresh preparation means for the apparatus, including which shared components are replaced or isolated.

initial_design.candidate_recipes: Two previously measured recipes: one near the chosen threshold and one separated from it. Select and record exact source-row identifiers before the run.
initial_design.predecessor_conditions: Three recorded, chemically compatible recipes with contrasting compositions in the eligible donor/acceptor domain.
initial_design.fresh_reference: An independently prepared reference for each candidate; the target assay and aging protocol match the shared-line samples.
initial_design.count_derivation: 2 candidates × [3 predecessor recipes × 3 wash conditions + 1 fresh-reference condition] × 6 replicates.
initial_design.conditioning_count: Predecessor preparations and their material/time use are additional charged operations. Their number and reuse must be fixed in the execution plan.
initial_design.blocking: Distribute cells across run days and substrate/plate positions. Randomize order within blocks while preserving the intentional predecessor-to-candidate sequence.
initial_design.power_status: Six replicates per cell is an initial calibration design, not a claim of adequate confirmatory power. Use its variance and quantification limits to size a separate confirmation stage for a scientifically chosen error tolerance.

record_for_every_operation: Run, day, apparatus, substrate and cell identifiers
Nominal composition, component amounts and actual dispensing resolution
Wash command, measured duration and consumed solvent/reagents
Composition-sensitive assay value with analytical uncertainty
Target photostability endpoint and replicate identifier
Elapsed critical-path time and operator-attendance time separately
Deviations and missing observations with reasons
analysis: Estimate history contrasts against the independently prepared reference, with day/substrate blocks retained.
Fit and challenge a retained-fraction or multi-reservoir model using composition measurements, not target-response fits alone.
Use a reserved calibration set to form conservative rho, eta, memory and noise bounds with explicit uncertainty.
Acknowledge that finite sampled slopes do not give a global physical Lipschitz upper bound; obtain an independently justified regularity envelope or restrict the claim.
Evaluate the frozen confirmation plans on new runs, including simple candidate repetition, prespecified burn-in, fixed washing and fresh-only preparation.
Report erroneous decisions, unresolved claims and useful confirmations together, with all resource quantities and exclusions.
Separate extra operator effort from extra campaign time because preparation and aging/assay operations may run in parallel.
completion_boundary: This plan is an executable study design to adapt with a laboratory. It is not a substitute for measured platform bounds or physical validation of the paper's confirmation method.
replication_definition: Each pilot replicate is an independently prepared specimen with its own target assay; technical re-readings alone do not supply preparation replication.
candidate_selection_refinement: Seek candidates on opposite sides of the photostability criterion using separate preliminary fresh measurements; this addresses the many all-valid simulation cases. Selection calibration is additional to the120target-assay grid and must be costed. This is a proposed refinement after the simulation results, not an executed analysis.
